title: Victory? Not Quite

Scene 18 — Victory? Not Quite

16:00–16:35 · 35 sec · District 7 streets

Cats read the Catnip Times. News of the suspicious payment spreads across the district. But the salmon shortage remains unresolved.

Shots: Newspaper close-up → street reactions → empty fish market → Trixie reading the report.
